name: XRP tie-goes-YES (last minute)
description: Taker: in the last minute of an XRP 15-minute window, buy YES at the proven ask (10-70c), once per market. XRP rounds strike and settlement to 4 decimals and 'at least' resolves ties YES, which the market ignores in the final minute.
hypothesis: XRP15M settles YES on ties (average >= strike) at 4-decimal precision; in the last minute the distribution of the final average is nearly known and discrete, so ties are common and YES is underpriced. Dev takers: YES +10..+14c, NO -16..-24c in the last minute (both halves, 200 days). Wrong if the walk-forward CI <= 0, 2x latency loses, or the lockbox (Sep-Oct) loses; also dies if market makers already price the tie.
